protectedAreaApplications: Skuleberget reserve sections 5/6, route portions section 5 approx km 16.12-19.62 + edge reentries, section 6 km 0.00-0.54. Apply only to portions/endpoints.

Skuleskogen national park sections 6/7/8, section 6 approx km 9.95-10.13 and 10.60-10.86, section 7 essentially whole line 0-7.50, section 8 no meaningful overlap after Entré Nord start. Apply full rules to section 7; section 6 endpoints/approach only; not all section 8.
Balesudden reserve section 8 approx km 12.20-18.29; section 9 no line overlap, Sandlågan start adjacent/outside. Apply to section 8 reserve segment and nearby facilities; not whole section 9.
staticWarningsToCarry: Slåttdalsskrevan status resolved-as-hazard-not-formal-closure; official wording says passage through not recommended due rockfall; no formal legal closure found. Model hazard/avoid-through-passage/use current route.
Hörnsjön active notice: 2026-01-09 lighted track out of function until further notice; carry caveat/recheck.
Section 7 cycling: suppress; current GPX not Kuststigen cycling corridor except tiny overlap.
dynamicPublicationChecks: Fire-ban status: no countywide ban on access date; dynamic recheck.
Recheck transit, seasonal boats, facility opening/currentness, and protected-area rule applicability before public display.

importOrder: 1. Import/parse the 9 current sections in official order.
2. Normalize route geometry from current Höga Kusten and Naturkartan section sources, keeping legacy 7-stage and 13-stage sources as caveats only.
3. Apply section 2 official-distance display policy and preserve computed/Naturkartan contradiction metadata.
4. Apply section 7 difficulty and Slåttdalsskrevan hazard/current-route warnings.
5. Preserve the Ullånger 24.8 m endpoint offset unless a logical junction/access node is needed by the graph.
6. Clip route segments and facilities against Skuleberget, Skuleskogen, Balesudden, and Hörnsjön only where recorded.
7. Promote verified facilities and keep pending/suppressed items out of public normalized facilities.
8. Replace transit IDs with authoritative GTFS/ResRobot IDs if available; otherwise keep research IDs caveated.
9. Run dynamic currentness/fire/transit/boat/service checks before publication.

blockers.description: Protected-area rules: apply Skuleskogen, Skuleberget, Balesudden, Hörnsjön rules only to affected portions recorded in packets/caveat file.

DinTur available through Trafiklab APIs but require API key; DinTur/Fskab planner stop-area IDs and WGS84 coords are research-grade, not final national IDs. Replace with Trafiklab/ResRobot before automated transit import if key available.
Slåttdalsskrevan, Hörnsjön notice, fire-ban status, transit, seasonal boats, and service opening/currentness require recheck before publication.
Pending/suppressed facility items must remain out of public normalized facilities until verified.

openDecisionsForUser.decision: Use Höga Kusten 26.8 km while preserving Naturkartan/GPX contradictions metadata.
